description: Keeping provider keys out of the run does not stop a bypassing request's body from leaving.

input.scenario: Only the guard holds provider keys, but outbound traffic is unrestricted. An extension sends a request containing CANARY-7f3a-SECRET, with no key, straight to the provider's public address, where a recording endpoint stands in.

expect.behaviour: This setup does not meet R019: the recording endpoint receives the unmasked canary before refusing the request for missing credentials.
